summary:
Project Summary: Mars Outpost Survival
1. Mars Outpost Survival is an interactive space-themed project focused on establishing and managing a human colony on Mars.
2. The main objective is to keep the astronauts alive for 30 Martian days (Sols).
3. The website introduces the project through an animated landing page featuring Mars-themed visuals and animations.
4. It includes a mini-game where players practise landing a spacecraft safely on Mars.
5. The main Unity game is embedded into the website using Unity WebGL.
6. Players manage five important resources: oxygen, water, food, power, and credits.
7. They must monitor their resources carefully to prevent the colony from running out of essential supplies.
8. Players can construct facilities such as water recyclers, solar panels, and greenhouses.
9. A Life Support Upgrade helps reduce oxygen consumption.
10. Random events, including dust storms, equipment failures, and discoveries, make each mission more challenging.
11. Warning messages and alarm sounds alert players when resources become critically low.
12. The game includes mission success and failure conditions based on resource management and survival.
13. An upgraded browser-based mission provides another interactive version of the Mars survival experience.
14. The project combines HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Unity to create an engaging web-based gaming experience.
details: Mars Outpost Survival is an interactive space-survival project in which players manage a human colony on Mars for 30 Martian days (Sols) by maintaining oxygen, water, food, power, and credits. Players can build facilities, upgrade life support, manage resources, and respond to random events to keep the astronauts alive. The project aims to develop problem-solving, decision-making, and resource-management skills while raising awareness about space exploration and sustainable living beyond Earth. We developed it using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the website and browser-based game, and Unity with C# for the main game, which was embedded using Unity WebGL. Its creativity comes from combining an animated Mars-themed website, a spacecraft landing mini-game, a Unity survival game, and an upgraded browser-based mission into one experience. Our team considered gameplay difficulty, user experience, resource balance, educational value, accessibility, visual design, and overall engagement while developing the project.
